invariants.rationale: The method intends to use fileName to load a TiledMap; null would be an error.
An empty fileName would not refer to a valid file and loading would likely fail.
Leading or trailing whitespace in fileName can cause file resolution issues.
TiledMap files commonly have a .tmx extension, and the loader is likely specialized for those files.
fileName typically represents a path or file, so it usually includes a directory separator or an extension period.
